title: CORRECTION of 20261125-031 and -035: CoreWeave has TWO 2031 bonds (9.00% due Feb 2031, 9.75% due Oct 2031); the 18% yield at a record low in Quartz is the 9%, and 17.91% in card 024 is the October bond, so they do not confirm each other
body:
# Two CoreWeave 2031 bonds (WALTER mixed them)

| Bond | Last price on the BOARD | Today |
|---|---|---|
| 9.00% February 2031 | 80.86, 15.33% [11/04, terminal screenshot, vendor unseen, card 20261105-010] | Quartz relaying Bloomberg: 18% yield, record low; no price given |
| 9.75% October 2031 | 79.48, 15.97% [11/04, same table] | 74.23, 17.91% [11/25 morning, Tradeweb via Reuters relay, card 024] |

- **Was:** 031 said the reported 'about 18%' on a 2031 bond 'agrees with' the October notes; 035 set the 9% bond beside the October notes as if one claim tested the other.
- **Is:** different coupons and maturities, so it is not confirmation. Both sit near 18%. @DeItaone's post did not name the bond; the Quartz text did.
- **Holds:** every other line of 031 as corrected by 035, and all of 035's loan facts. The June 2030 record low (024) is a third bond.
- **So what:** no read changes; the distress level is the same by either bond. Name coupon and maturity on any CoreWeave bond figure.
dispatch_note: Correction of WALTER's own bond identity. Recipients = union of 031 and 035. R1 COR-20261125-36; banners on both. TERRY BOARD-only.
